title: drop --commit names only the dropped ids in KB-Work, though it also commits the neighbour item files it cleaned (relates_to, depends_on, gate do)
goal: drop --commit names in KB-Work every id whose item file the commit changes, the neighbours it cleaned of a relates_to, depends_on or gate do link included

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", d, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
    bl = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "--root", d, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
    g("init", "-q"); g("config", "user.email", "x@example.com"); g("config", "user.name", "x")
    open(os.path.join(d, "README"), "w").write("x\n"); g("add", "."); g("commit", "-qm", "init")
    a = bl("new", "story", "--title", "A", "--goal", "g", "--commit").stdout.split()[2]
    b = bl("new", "story", "--title", "B", "--goal", "g", "--commit").stdout.split()[2]
    assert bl("set", b, "--add-relates", a, "--commit").returncode == 0, "set relates"
    r = bl("drop", a, "--why", "planted", "--commit")
    body = g("log", "-1", "--format=%B").stdout
    changed = g("show", "--name-only", "--format=", "HEAD").stdout
    kb = [l for l in body.splitlines() if l.startswith("KB-Work:")]
    missing = [i for i in (a, b) if (i + ".json") in changed and not any(i in l for l in kb)]
    print("drop rc", r.returncode, "KB-Work:", kb, "files:", changed.split(), "not named:", missing)
    sys.exit(1 if missing else 0)
